caption:
Figure 4. (a) Illustrates the training stage of the GenDeg model where it is trained to condition on the clean image, text prompt and mean
intensity (µ) and variation (σ) of the degradation pattern. (b) Shows the inference stage where the model generates a degraded image based
on these conditions; and (c) Depicts the architecture of the Swin-transformer-based restoration network.
delegated_acceptance_review: Actually viewed final and initial draft, read caption and all independent pair observations. Final retains original training/noise/latent/conditioning paths, all text examples, clean/degraded stacks, structure correction/filtering outputs, five restoration blocks and three skip links, decoder inset and full symbol legend. The initial erroneous conditioning-arrow rendering is absent after source restoration. Moved a/b/c headings and mean-intensity/variation footer match original caption; no formula, data panel or branch is reinterpreted.
